home.defaultDescription: See what's available and book online at {name}.

booking.title: Book an appointment

services.heading: What would you like booked?
services.hint: Pick one or more. They'll run back to back in one appointment.
services.empty: Nothing is bookable online right now.

location.heading: Which location?
location.hint: Pick where you'd like to be seen.

professional.heading: Who would you like to see?
professional.empty: Nobody at this location performs everything you've chosen. Try another location or fewer services.

time.heading: Pick a time
time.noSlots: Nothing open on this day. Try another date.

details.heading: Your details
details.name: Name
details.emailHint: Add one and we'll email you a link to change or cancel this booking. Without it, the link on the next screen is your only copy.
details.slotTaken: That time was taken while you were filling this in. Please pick another.

confirmed.heading: You're booked
confirmed.body: We've emailed {email} a link you can use to change or cancel this appointment.
confirmed.noEmailYet: Keep this link — it's how you get back to this booking.
confirmed.bodyNoEmail: Keep the link below — without an email address, it's the only way back to this booking.

booking.unavailableBody: This business's booking settings need attention, so appointments can't be taken online right now. Please contact them directly.

verify.heading: Confirm your number
verify.devCode: SMS isn't connected yet, so here's your code:
verify.wrongCode: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Try again or send a new one.
verify.sendFailed: We couldn't send a code just now. Please try again.

manage.heading: Your appointment
manage.invalid: This link is no longer valid. It may have expired, or the appointment may have been cancelled.
manage.rescheduleNote: Changing the time replaces this link with a new one, which we'll email you.

resend.heading: Resend your booking link
resend.hint: Enter the phone number you booked with and we'll email the link again.
resend.done: If that number has an upcoming booking with us, we've just emailed the link.
